subject.title: [Feature]: 内置健壮性机制：Watchdog、全局错误处理、自动恢复

question: Should OpenClaw core keep this as the umbrella for a built-in Gateway recovery design, and which recovery actions should be default-on versus explicit opt-in?
rationale: The remaining work spans process supervision, repair execution, notifications, health schema, startup fallback, and security boundaries, so source inspection cannot safely choose the permanent product contract.

options.title: Keep Design Umbrella
options.body: Use this issue to anchor the maintainer-approved Gateway resilience design while narrower PRs/issues implement specific slices.

options.title: Move to Narrow Canonicals
options.body: Close this only after the remaining watchdog, crash ladder, health-schema, and recovery-policy pieces are each assigned to active canonical issues or PRs.

options.title: Reject Core Ownership
options.body: Declare this an external supervisor/plugin pattern and document the supported boundary instead of adding more core recovery semantics.

recommendation.title: Keep Design Umbrella
recommendation.body: Use this issue to anchor the maintainer-approved Gateway resilience design while narrower PRs/issues implement specific slices.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the broadest recent history across the Gateway health, startup, error, and docs surfaces involved in the product decision.
